answer_1.quote: We introduce a new framework, dataset, and leaderboard to generatively evaluate real-world language use.
answer_1.outputs: advice in natural language to help individuals facing real-world situations

answer_4.quote: Workers on Mechanical Turk then compare the helpfulness of the model-generated advice with human-written advice, and provide diagnostic ratings.
answer_4.guideline: Workers are given a situation and two pieces of advice. First, they choose which is more helpful. Second, they rate the helpfulness of the worse advice; last, they answer a diagnostic question.
